title: Observability-driven calibration canary with automated rollback to higher-precision variants
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Add an observability-first canary and automated fallback flow for FP8/INT8 quantized model variants. The goal is to enable safe progressive rollout of quantized artifacts by tying runtime telemetry and accuracy validation to automatic traffic routing and rollback. This ticket covers the calibration harness integration, canary traffic rules, accuracy gates (offline + online), and automated fallback to a higher-precision variant (FP16/FP32) plus audit events for post-mortem. Emphasis on minimal user-visible regressions and preserving KV cache compatibility and state across fallback transitions.
acceptance_criteria: Can deploy a quantized variant behind a canary spec that receives 1-5% traffic and gradually ramps to target using metric gates
Offline calibration produces a per-layer profile and calibration artifacts are stored and reproducible
Online accuracy validation evaluates sampling of responses against golden prompt set and raises a red/amber/green status
If accuracy gate breaches (red) or latency SLO degrades beyond threshold for 3 consecutive evaluation windows, system automatically shifts traffic to fallback variant and flags the canary as failed
All fallback events emit audit logs with calibration artifact id, canary id, metrics snapshot, and responsible rollout config
Canary lifecycle and fallback are configurable by project: thresholds, sample sizes, lookback windows, and allowed fallback targets
implementation_notes: Extend calib-harness to export a canonical calibration bundle: profile.json + per-layer scales + representative-statistics-blob

Create canary controller that evaluates two signal families: (1) offline validation score delta on golden prompts (n=500 by default), (2) online telemetry (latency P50/P95/P99, token-error-rate proxies, prompt-similarity drift)
Define acceptance gating: green (>99% pass on golden set and no P95 regression >20%), amber (partial regressions; hold and increase sampling), red (<95% pass or P95 regression >40%)
Fallback targets prioritized: FP16-quantized variant with same weights -> FP32 if FP16 not available. Fallback must reuse KV cache keys where possible or warm cache via traffic shadowing
Add safe-switch choreography: drain canary worker pool, route new sessions to fallback model, continue serving existing sessions if cache-compatible; else gracefully restart sessions with notice
Persist calibration bundle id and canary id in model metadata for traceability
Expose canary state and recent validation histograms in Console and evaluation dashboard with link to PR/commit that produced quantized artifact
progress_updates: 2026-03-02: Spike completed for calibration bundle format and storage path. Decided on bundle schema v1 (profile.json + layer_scales.npy + rep_stats.pb). Confluence spec: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Calibration+Bundle+Spec
2026-03-04: Prototype canary controller implemented that reads metrics from metrics-api and computes rolling window stats. Initial thresholds are configurable via canary config CRD.

2026-03-06: Integration test harness added to CI that runs a lightweight golden-set check for INT8 artifacts produced by the quantizer. Found mean BLEU-like drop of 0.8% on a draft INT8 profile for model-xl; flagged for calibration tweak.
2026-03-08: Worked with Applied ML (Jordan Liu) to add per-layer outlier clipping to calibration step which reduced token-level hallucination proxies on initial tests.

2026-03-10: First end-to-end dry run: deployed canary for fp8-small candidate, sampled 2% traffic and shadowed to fallback FP16. Online validation hooks recorded small semantic drift -> canary halted automatically after 2 windows and traffic shifted to fallback as expected. Creating follow-up to tune golden-set composition and sample sizes. GitHub PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2764
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: False positives from online proxies could trigger unnecessary rollbacks; Mitigation: require sustained breach over multiple windows and combine with offline golden-set checks
Risk: KV cache incompatibility between quantized and fallback variants causing cold starts; Mitigation: enforce cache-key schema compatibility and add cache-warming shadow traffic before switch
Risk: Calibration bundles non-reproducible across quantizer versions; Mitigation: include quantizer binary sha and hyperparameters in bundle metadata and store in immutable artifact registry
Risk: Customer SLA exposure during canary; Mitigation: limit initial traffic and ensure fast automatic fallback to reserved dedicated capacity if needed
next_steps: Tune golden prompt set to include more long-context examples and failure-mode prompts (in progress with Research)
Expose canary config knobs in Console UI and add an approval step for high-impact projects
Add automatic incident notification to on-call Slack channel and create a PagerDuty play when fallback occurs for >10% traffic within 1 hour
Land changes from runtime PR and run full-scale canary against dedicated infra during next maintenance window
